drag-sortable-list.purpose: Reorder dashboard modules, route stops, rules, or settings with keyboard alternatives, undo, persistence, and reduced-motion behavior.
useWhen: Order changes process meaning or presentation.
Users need drag plus keyboard reorder controls.
Reordering persists, audits, or affects routes, dashboards, or rules.
doNotUseWithoutReview: Persistence, constraints, or undo behavior is unclear.
Drag is the only way to reorder.
foundations: Defines list density, handles, drop targets, and responsive controls.
Owns reorder labels, position copy, undo, and save feedback.
Controls grabbed, target, selected, disabled, and saved states.
Idle, grabbed, moved, dirty, saved, blocked, disabled, and error states are explicit.
Movement is meaningful, bounded, and respects reduced motion.
Keyboard reorder and position announcements are required.
variants: Order affects navigation and requires review.
Move up/down controls work without drag.
motion: Motion follows system timing and is disabled by reduced motion.
accessibility: Drag is not the only input method.

canDecide: Use Drag Sortable List when order has product meaning.
Use Motion Boundary for local motion behavior.
mustAsk: Persistence, constraints, audit, undo, or order meaning is unclear.
Reordering affects routes, finance, compliance, or safety.
rejectIf: No save or undo policy exists.
miel.handoff: Confirm order meaning, constraints, persistence, keyboard controls, undo, audit, and reduced-motion behavior.
